endorsements.quote: Before implementation of GenAI tools, integration into IT and clinical workflows should also undergo pilot testing to mitigate errors.
Leading public and physician education through social media campaigns and CME courses on GenAI capabilities, limitations, and ethical use.
Leading public and physician education through social media campaigns and CME courses on GenAI capabilities, limitations, and ethical use.
The task force should ensure that GenAI tools used in healthcare organizations comply with Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) regulations.
Of note, the topic of patient consent in the setting of using patient data for training of GenAI tools as well as using such tools in the clinical settings should be discussed.

unlisted_practices: Radiology training programs should allocate dedicated time for AI-specific training and offer a specific curriculum that includes GenAI.
Radiology organizations should address security measures with developers before implementation.
Developers should disclose financial and intellectual property protection policies.
Developers should ensure AI's actions align with human values and minimize black-box algorithms by creating explainable AI.
Developers should offer transparency of the data sets used for GenAI training.
Any GenAI-produced content in scientific publication must be proofread and include human input.
Admissions committees should receive training and guidance on tools like ChatGPT for fair use and informed decision-making.
Train GenAI systems on diverse, representative data from patients with varying degrees of access to healthcare technologies.
Establish a multi-society GenAI task force among radiological societies to develop guidelines for GenAI integration into clinical care, policy, and education.
Prioritize patient data protection against AI-related hacking threats.

screen.reason: Editorial proposing a multi-society generative AI task force within radiology to establish guidelines for clinical care, health policy, and education.
